# Dictate Text

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Creates text from a dictation.

## Syntax

~~~~text
dictateText(language: <#Enumeration (WFSpeechLanguage) (Optional)#>, endTrigger: <#Enumeration (WFDictateTextStopListening) (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
dictateText(language: en-US, endTrigger: After Pause)
~~~~
